  customer VPC, or fully air\\-gapped

  limits, and ship them through CI

  opening a production shell, because on a client site you often cannot
 



  





 WHAT YOU BRING
 



 \\- This is connector and deployment work, not data pipeline engineering.
 



  If your experience is Spark, Databricks, ADF or warehouse ETL, it is

 \\- Production connectors in both a cloud environment and an on\\-prem or
 



  VPC environment
 



 \\- Automated tests and a CI path you have used to deploy an integration
 



  change
 



 \\- Comfort reading an unfamiliar schema and working out what it holds

 BONUS

  production

 \\- BFSI exposure: core banking, lending, wealth or insurance systems

 WEAKER FIT
 



 \\- Primarily data pipeline / ETL engineering, ML research, frontend,
 



  analytics or BI
 



 \\- Primarily ML research, frontend, analytics or BI
 



 \\- DevOps or platform work without substantial connector and API
 



  development
 



 \\- Work that is mostly configuring an iPaaS rather than building
 



  connectors
 



  





 We hire people who have written integrations and debugged them in
 



 production. Configuring an integration platform, without building the
 



 connector underneath, is a weaker fit.
 



  





 Founding role. Direct work with the founders, no layers.
 



 ₹18–32L plus ESOP, depending on depth.
 



  





 TO APPLY
 



  





 Email your CV to privacy@complydp.com with one paragraph: describe a
